content: The salicylate levels increase when administered at moderate doses but decrease at higher doses due to enhanced renal excretion of unchanged salicylic acid. This requires close monitoring. Calcium carbonate enhances the effects of digoxin through pharmacodynamic synergy. It also increases digoxin levels by raising gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Famotidine similarly increases digoxin levels by raising gastric pH, applicable only to oral forms. Digoxin reduces magnesium hydroxide levels by increasing renal clearance. This interaction is minor, with unknown clinical significance. Calcium carbonate reduces the effects of diltiazem through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Magnesium hydroxide decreases dolutegravir levels by cation binding in the gastrointestinal tract. Dolutegravir should be administered two hours before or six hours after medications containing polyvalent cations. Calcium carbonate similarly decreases dolutegravir levels via cation binding. Therapy modification or close monitoring is recommended. Doxercalciferol increases magnesium hydroxide levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. This interaction applies only to oral forms. Magnesium hydroxide reduces doxycycline levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Calcium carbonate also decreases doxycycline levels through the same mechanism. These interactions apply only to oral forms, and alternative drugs or a two-hour separation are recommended. Drospirenone increases magnesium hydroxide levels by reducing renal clearance and decreases calcium carbonate levels by increasing renal clearance. The clinical significance of these interactions is unknown. Calcium carbonate decreases eltrombopag levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Magnesium hydroxide has a similar effect. These interactions are contraindicated, and a separation of at least four hours is advised. Calcium carbonate reduces elvitegravir levels by cation binding in the gastrointestinal tract. This interaction is not due to changes in gastric pH. A two-hour separation from antacids is recommended. Calcium carbonate also decreases levels of elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF through gastrointestinal absorption inhibition. Caution and close monitoring are advised. Calcium carbonate reduces enalapril effects through an unspecified mechanism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Calcium carbonate increases ephedrine levels by passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Close monitoring is advised. Famotidine increases erdafitinib levels by reducing renal clearance. Calcium carbonate interacts with erdafitinib, and coadministration should be avoided during the initial dosing adjustment period (first 21 days). Serum phosphate binders may obscure decisions regarding dosage increases. Famotidine decreases erlotinib levels through an unspecified mechanism. Erlotinib should be taken 10 hours after an H2-antagonist and at least two hours before the next dose of the H2-antagonist. Calcium carbonate increases erythromycin base, ethylsuccinate, lactobionate, and stearate levels through an unknown mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Calcium carbonate reduces esmolol effects through an unspecified mechanism and decreases esmolol levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. A two-hour separation is recommended. Estradiol decreases magnesium hydroxide levels by shifting magnesium from blood to tissue storage. The clinical significance is unknown. Calcium carbonate reduces estramustine levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Estramustine should be taken with water at least one hour before or two hours after meals. Conjugated synthetic estrogens, esterified estrogens, and estropipate decrease magnesium hydroxide levels by shifting magnesium from blood to tissue storage. The clinical significance is unknown. Ethacrynic acid decreases magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate levels by increasing renal clearance. The clinical significance is unknown. Calcium carbonate reduces etidronate levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. A 30-minute separation is recommended. Calcium carbonate reduces felodipine effects through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Calcium carbonate decreases ferric maltol levels by increasing gastric pH and inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Famotidine has a similar effect. A two-hour separation is recommended. Ferrous fumarate increases calcium carbonate levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. Calcium carbonate decreases ferrous fumarate levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. The clinical significance is unknown. Famotidine decreases ferrous gluconate levels by increasing gastric pH. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. A two-hour separation is recommended. Ferrous sulfate increases calcium carbonate levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. Calcium carbonate decreases ferrous sulfate levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. The clinical significance is unknown. Calcium carbonate increases flecainide levels by passive renal tubular reabsorption in basic urine. Close monitoring is advised. Magnesium hydroxide decreases fleroxacin levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. A two-hour separation is recommended. Fludrocortisone decreases calcium carbonate levels by increasing elimination. The clinical significance is unknown. Famotidine decreases fosamprenavir levels by increasing gastric pH. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. Caution and monitoring are advised. Calcium carbonate reduces fosinopril effects through an unspecified mechanism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Furosemide decreases calcium carbonate and magnesium hydroxide levels by increasing renal clearance. The clinical significance is unknown. Calcium carbonate decreases gabapentin and gabapentin enacarbil levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. A two-hour separation is recommended. Calcium carbonate decreases gefitinib levels by increasing gastric pH. Famotidine has a similar effect. Gefitinib and H2-antagonist doses should be separated by at least six hours. Magnesium hydroxide decreases gemifloxacin levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. A two-hour separation is recommended. Gentamicin decreases magnesium hydroxide and calcium carbonate levels by increasing renal clearance. The clinical significance is unknown. Famotidine increases glipizide levels by increasing gastric pH. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. Caution and monitoring are advised. Glucagon intranasal increases magnesium hydroxide levels by reducing renal clearance. The clinical significance is unknown. Famotidine increases glyburide levels by increasing gastric pH. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. Caution and monitoring are advised. Hydrochlorothiazide increases calcium carbonate levels by reducing renal clearance and decreases magnesium hydroxide levels by increasing renal clearance. The clinical significance is unknown. Hydrocortisone decreases calcium carbonate levels by increasing elimination. The clinical significance is unknown. Calcium carbonate decreases ibandronate levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Magnesium hydroxide has a similar effect. A two-hour separation is recommended. Calcium carbonate reduces imidapril effects through an unspecified mechanism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Indapamide increases calcium carbonate levels by reducing renal clearance and decreases magnesium hydroxide levels by increasing renal clearance. The clinical significance is unknown. Famotidine decreases indinavir levels by increasing gastric pH. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. Alternative drugs are recommended. Calcium carbonate decreases infigratinib levels by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. Magnesium hydroxide and famotidine have similar effects. If acid-reducing agents cannot be avoided, infigratinib should be administered two hours before or 10 hours after an H2-antagonist. Famotidine decreases iron dextran complex levels by increasing gastric pH. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. A two-hour separation is recommended. Iron dextran complex increases calcium carbonate levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. The clinical significance is unknown. Famotidine decreases iron sucrose levels by increasing gastric pH. Calcium carbonate has a similar effect. A two-hour separation is recommended. Iron sucrose increases calcium carbonate levels by enhancing gastrointestinal absorption. The clinical significance is unknown. Isavuconazonium sulfate interactions were incomplete in the provided text.
